newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end on 70-mth high,more gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end on 70-mth high,more gains seen.

text.p: Austrian shares powered higher on Tuesday to a new 70-month closing high on positive international leads and dollar strength.
Traders said the uptrend should continue in the near future but noted there could be some profit taking at the current high levels. Technical analysts said the market was overbought.
The ATX index jumped to a fresh year high of 1,244.52 before easing to close 3.83 points or 0.31 percent up at 1,240.84.
Among its constituents 12 shares gained, seven lost and two were unchanged.
"At the beginning the index was really bullish, then it calmed down again," said one trader.
Microchip maker AMS was the top gainer, climbing 4.87 percent to 184 schillings.
Textilemaker Lenzing was led the decliners, falling 1.72 percent to 570 schillings.
The March ATX future added 12.5 points at 1,249.
